title: "Disaster Tourism: New York City 2009"
date: "2009-03-11"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

Have just returned from Freddie and Fannie-ravaged America.  John Green provides a perspective on the special MPS meeting in New York in the [Business Spectator](http://www.businessspectator.com.au/bs.nsf/Article/Now-thats-an-economic-conservative-$pd20090310-PYQT9?OpenDocument&src=sph "Business Spectator"). 

While I was away, I had an op-ed in [The Australian](http://www.theaustralian.news.com.au/business/story/0,,25135036-36418,00.html "The Australian") on the proposed increase in Chinalco’s stake in Rio.  I was also interviewed on the same subject by the Chinese-language [21st Century Business Herald](http://www.nanfangdaily.com.cn/epaper/21cn/content/20090316/ArticelJ03002FM.htm "21st Century Business Herald").
